description_en: Describes the syntax and examples of the CompareFace operation in the facebody category
description_zh: 本文介绍人脸人体（facebody）类目下的人脸比对CompareFace的语法及示例
name: CompareFace

parameters.help_en: The quality score threshold. The system analyzes and evaluates the quality of the face images. If the quality score of a face is less than this threshold, a MessageTips description is added to the response
parameters.help_zh: 质量分阈值，对人脸图片进行质量分析判断，若某张人脸质量分小于该阈值，则会在返回结果上增加MessageTips说明
parameters.name: quality_score_threshold

parameters.help_en:
The URL of Image A. We recommend that you use an OSS URL in the China (Shanghai) region. For files stored locally or in OSS buckets outside the China (Shanghai) region, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html.

You must specify either ImageURLA or ImageDataA. If both the URL and Base64 encoding methods are used, the URL method takes precedence
parameters.help_zh:
图像A的URL地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html。

ImageURLA与ImageDataA二选一，当URL方式与Base64编码方式共存时，URL方式优先
parameters.name: image_url_a

parameters.help_en:
The URL of Image B. We recommend that you use an OSS URL in the China (Shanghai) region. For files stored locally or in OSS buckets outside the China (Shanghai) region, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html.
You must specify either ImageURLB or ImageDataB. If both the URL and Base64 encoding methods are used, the URL method takes precedence
parameters.help_zh:
图像B的URL地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html。
ImageURLB与ImageDataB二选一，当URL方式与Base64编码方式共存时，URL方式优先
parameters.name: image_url_b

parameters.help_en:
The Base64-encoded string of Image A. If both the URL and Base64 encoding methods are used, the URL method takes precedence. For more information about how to encode a file in Base64, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/468191.html.
You must specify either ImageURLA or ImageDataA. If both the URL and Base64 encoding methods are used, the URL method takes precedence

parameters.name: image_data_b

Confidence.description_en: The confidence score that the largest faces in the two images belong to the same person. Valid values: 0 to 100. The three reference thresholds are 61, 69, and 75, which correspond to false acceptance rates of 1/1,000, 1/10,000, and 1/100,000, respectively. A higher threshold results in a lower false acceptance rate and a lower pass rate. You can set a higher threshold for scenarios with higher security requirements. If no face is detected in an image, an error message is returned
Confidence.description_zh: 两张图片中的最大人脸属于同一个人的置信度，取值范围0~100。供参考的三个阈值是61，69和75，分别对应千分之一，万分之一和十万分之一误识率。阈值设置越高，误识率越低，通过率也越低，对安全性要求越高的场合，可以设置更高的阈值。如果某张图片中没有人脸，则报错误信息

IsMaskA.description_en:
Indicates whether the face in Image A wears a mask.
0: No.
1: Yes
IsMaskA.description_zh:

0：不戴口罩。
1：戴口罩

IsMaskB.description_en:
Indicates whether the face in Image B wears a mask.
0: No.
1: Yes
IsMaskB.description_zh:
图片B中的人脸是否戴口罩。
0：不戴口罩。

items.description_en: The coordinates of the facial landmarks corresponding to the face bounding box in Image A. The sequence is the horizontal coordinate of the left eye, the vertical coordinate of the left eye, the horizontal coordinate of the right eye, the vertical coordinate of the right eye, the horizontal coordinate of the nose tip, the vertical coordinate of the nose tip, the horizontal coordinate of the left mouth corner, the vertical coordinate of the left mouth corner, the horizontal coordinate of the right mouth corner, and the vertical coordinate of the right mouth corner
items.description_zh: 图片A人脸框所对应的人脸关键点坐标，顺序分别为左眼水平坐标，左眼垂直坐标，右眼水平坐标，右眼垂直坐标，鼻尖水平坐标，鼻尖垂直坐标，左嘴角水平坐标，左嘴角垂直坐标，右嘴角水平坐标，右嘴角垂直坐标

items.description_en: The coordinates of the facial landmarks corresponding to the face bounding box in Image B. The sequence is the horizontal coordinate of the left eye, the vertical coordinate of the left eye, the horizontal coordinate of the right eye, the vertical coordinate of the right eye, the horizontal coordinate of the nose tip, the vertical coordinate of the nose tip, the horizontal coordinate of the left mouth corner, the vertical coordinate of the left mouth corner, the horizontal coordinate of the right mouth corner, and the vertical coordinate of the right mouth corner
items.description_zh: 图片B人脸框所对应的人脸关键点坐标，顺序分别为左眼水平坐标，左眼垂直坐标，右眼水平坐标，右眼垂直坐标，鼻尖水平坐标，鼻尖垂直坐标，左嘴角水平坐标，左嘴角垂直坐标，右嘴角水平坐标，右嘴角垂直坐标

MessageTips.description_en:
The prompt information in plain text. The following prompt messages may appear individually or in combination.
Quality-related prompts (displayed when the quality score of a face is less than the quality score threshold specified in the request parameters):
`imageA quality score less threshold`: The quality score of Image A is less than the threshold specified in the input parameters.
`imageB quality score less threshold`: The quality score of Image B is less than the threshold specified in the input parameters.

Face size-related prompts (displayed when a face is detected and the width or height of the face is less than 50 pixels. If this prompt appears, provide a face with more than 64 × 64 pixels and refer to the returned Confidence value as appropriate):
`face in imageA is too small`: The face in Image A is too small.
`face in imageB is too small`: The face in Image B is too small
MessageTips.description_zh:
提示信息，纯文字描述，以下提示信息单独出现或是几条提示信息的组合。
质量相关提示（某张人脸质量分小于请求参数质量分阈值时会出现）：
`imageA quality score less threshold`：图像A的质量分小于输入参数设置的阈值。
`imageB quality score less threshold`：图像B的质量分小于输入参数设置的阈值。

人脸尺寸相关提示（检测到人脸且人脸宽或高小于50像素时会有该提示信息。出现该提示信息时，请尽可能输入像素数大于64x64的人脸，并请酌情参考返回的对比置信度Confidence值）：
`face in imageA is too small`：图像A中的人脸太小。
`face in imageB is too small`：图像B中的人脸太小
MessageTips.title_en: 信息提示信息，纯文字描述，目前支持质量分的提示信息
MessageTips.title_zh: 信息提示信息，纯文字描述，目前支持质量分的提示信息

QualityScoreA.description_en: The quality score of Image A

QualityScoreB.description_en: The quality score of Image B

items.description_en: The rectangular bounding box of the largest face in Image A in the `[left, top, width, height]` format. Example: `[157,82,147,188]`
items.description_zh: 图片A中最大人脸矩形框`[left, top, width, height]`，例如`[157,82,147,188]`

items.description_en: The rectangular bounding box of the largest face in Image B in the `[left, top, width, height]` format. Example: `[169,48,125,162]`
items.description_zh: 图片B中最大人脸矩形框`[left, top, width, height]`，例如`[169,48,125,162]`

items.description_en: The confidence thresholds corresponding to false acceptance rates of 1/1,000, 1/10,000, and 1/100,000. For example, `[61.0,69.0,75.0]` indicates that if the false acceptance rate is 1/1,000, a confidence score greater than 61% means the two faces belong to the same person
items.description_zh: 误识率在1/1000，1/10000，1/100000的情况下分别对应的置信度阈值。例如`[61.0,69.0,75.0]`，表示误识率为1/1000的情况下，置信度（Confidence）超过61%就可以认为是同一个人
